# Vo Dac The — Complete Technical & Executive Dossier

## Executive Summary (EN)
Technology leader and hands-on Software Engineering professional with nearly 10 years of experience (2016–Present) building high-availability distributed systems, multi-tenant microservices, cloud-native Kubernetes platforms, and pragmatic AI/LLM solutions across Travel Technology, Industrial IoT, and Identity & Access Management.

Bridging executive technology strategy with deep engineering execution — mentoring high-performing teams, hardening production observability, and turning complex business operations into resilient software platforms.

## Tóm tắt Điều hành (VI)
Lãnh đạo công nghệ và chuyên gia kỹ thuật phần mềm thực chiến với gần 10 năm kinh nghiệm (2016–Nay) trực tiếp xây dựng hệ thống phân tán chịu tải cao, kiến trúc microservices đa thuê bao (multi-tenant), hạ tầng Cloud-Native trên Kubernetes và các giải pháp AI/LLM thực tiễn trong lĩnh vực TravelTech, Industrial IoT và Quản lý Định danh (IAM).

Kết nối tầm nhìn công nghệ cấp điều hành với năng lực triển khai mã nguồn thực chiến — dẫn dắt đội ngũ kỹ sư, chuẩn hóa khả năng quan sát hệ thống (observability) và biến bài toán vận hành phức tạp thành nền tảng phần mềm bền vững.

## Professional Experience
### CTO – Chief Technology Officer — Tripdata (12/2024 – Present)
Location: Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam | Domain: B2B TravelTech & Digital Distribution

Leading technology strategy, software engineering, and platform development at Tripdata, a B2B travel technology infrastructure company powering digital travel distribution, agent portals, and commercial consolidator operations (including ecosystems connected with SkyJet).

Key Responsibilities:
- Applied AI (Generative AI, LLM & RAG) to replace the traditional manual booker team — automating fare-rule/policy interpretation, booking diagnostics, and ticketing operations to optimize profit margins and maximize the end-user experience.
- Built a flexible pricing-configuration system and strong B2B sales tooling: sub-agents at every tier can easily declare their own service fees, with clear, real-time profit and revenue reporting.
- Established proactive operations monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry) with early error alerting, cutting recovery time (RTO) dramatically compared with traditional travel systems.
- Architected a high-load, multi-tenant microservices platform (PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, YARP/Nginx) built to integrate with the region's leading OTAs.
- Designed a flexible unified API: a single API set serving many domestic and international airlines, including foreign carriers.
- Define company-wide technology strategy and roadmaps; lead and mentor engineering teams with clear standards, code review culture, and delivery best practices.
- Oversee end-to-end B2B travel platforms covering domestic and international airline ticketing, hotel distribution, and specialized SOTO (Sold Outside, Ticketed Outside) / SITI (Sold Inside, Ticketed Inside) workflows.
- Direct multi-cloud infrastructure (Azure, AWS), Docker/Kubernetes orchestration, and CI/CD automation (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).

Technology Stack: .NET Core, C#, React, Flutter, Microservices, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Docker, Azure, AWS, RabbitMQ, YARP, Nginx, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry, AI/LLM, RAG

### Technical Lead / Solution Architecture Support — Yokogawa Electric Corporation (09/2021 – 09/2024)
Location: Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam | Domain: Industrial IoT (IIoT) & Asset Performance Management

Contributed to OpreX Asset Health Insights, Yokogawa's cloud-based Industrial IoT (IIoT) SaaS platform unifying operational technology (OT) sensor/process telemetry with IT systems for enterprise asset monitoring and operational intelligence.

Key Responsibilities:
- Built a robust IoT connectivity layer, load-tested with more than 2,000 devices connected concurrently without issue.
- Delivered multi-platform device connectivity across MQTT, RabbitMQ, MQTTX, Azure, and other industrial channels, alongside real-time telemetry (SignalR, CoAP).
- Applied machine learning to IoT telemetry to generate early-warning alerts and power flexible profit and cost calculation for plant operations.
- Implemented strict role-based access control for multiple engineering teams — no team can exceed its granted permissions — using OpenID Connect (OIDC) and IdentityServer4, fit for enterprise systems.
- Provided technical solutions and architectural recommendations; led technical discussions, sprint planning, and estimation across distributed engineering squads.
- Mentored developers and enforced engineering standards through thorough code reviews and clean microservices boundaries in .NET Core / C#.
- Supported multi-cloud deployments across Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Alibaba Cloud using Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Helm, and Azure DevOps CI/CD.

Technology Stack: .NET Core, C#, Microservices, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, RabbitMQ, SignalR, CoAP, MQTT, Machine Learning, Azure, AWS, Alibaba Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Helm, Azure DevOps, OIDC, IdentityServer4

### Senior Software Engineer — NashTech (10/2020 – 02/2022)
Location: Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam | Domain: Biometric Authentication & Enterprise IAM (Evolution Wellness)

Engineered enterprise software solutions for Evolution Wellness, one of Asia's largest fitness and wellness operators (brands including Fitness First and Celebrity Fitness), focusing on facial recognition verification, identity management, and physical access control.

Key Responsibilities:
- Developed facial recognition-based authentication capabilities to accurately identify and verify fitness club members.
- Built identity management and membership verification microservices supporting secure, low-friction member check-ins.
- Integrated backend services with physical facility access control hardware so only authorized members enter clubs.
- Implemented strict authentication and authorization flows using IdentityServer4, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect (OIDC) to protect sensitive member data.
- Designed scalable .NET Core microservices on Microsoft Azure with Azure Service Bus and Microsoft SQL Server.
- Proposed technical approaches, participated in solution design reviews, and collaborated directly with US-based stakeholders. Named NashTech Developer of the Year (2022).

Technology Stack: C#, .NET Core, Microservices, Microsoft Azure, Azure Service Bus, Microsoft SQL Server, IdentityServer4, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), REST APIs

- Improved system throughput and database efficiency through Redis caching strategies and targeted SQL Server query optimization.

Context: Modernizing fragmented B2B airline ticketing, hotel distribution, and agency operations across multi-provider suppliers (GDS, LCCs, regional carriers, eSIM, transfers) and specialized SOTO/SITI ticketing channels.

- Production Kubernetes on Azure and AWS with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki monitoring — early error alerts and far faster RTO than traditional systems.

Organization / Source: FPT Telecom | Period: 11/2019 – 10/2020

### Smart Companion & Smart Core (Smart Glasses Control Suite) [CLOSED SOURCE · ★9 GITHUB · ANDROID / BT]
Organization / Source: github.com/vodacthe/smart_companion | Period: Closed Source
Context: Closed-source paired Android ecosystem enabling smartphones to act as a low-friction remote control, HUD bridge, and file manager for Smart Glasses, Android TVs, and tablets.

Architectural Highlights:
- Dual-app architecture: Smart Core runs on the target glasses/TV receiver while Smart Companion runs on the controller phone over Bluetooth.

Stack: Android, Bluetooth, HUD Navigation, Remote Control, File Transfer

### AR Air Mouse — Hands-Free Gesture Cursor for AR Glasses [CLOSED SOURCE · ★5 GITHUB · PLAY STORE]
Organization / Source: github.com/vodacthe/ar_air_mouse | Period: Closed Source
Context: Closed-source spatial interaction app that eliminates reaching for a phone screen while wearing AR glasses by converting subtle head motion and natural micro-gestures into a virtual pointer.

Architectural Highlights:
- Uses Android AccessibilityService API to render a floating virtual cursor and dispatch touch/scroll/navigation gestures globally.
- Supports custom gesture mapping (including bite/tap triggers), zoom/scroll actions, and built-in Speech-to-Text dictation.

Stack: Android, AccessibilityService, AR Glasses, Gesture Recognition, Speech-to-Text
Links: Release & Docs (GitHub) (https://github.com/vodacthe/ar_air_mouse)

### Decal Unwrap — Browser 3D-to-2D True-Scale Cut Template Engine [OPEN SOURCE · LIVE WEB APP · 3D GEOMETRY]
Organization / Source: github.com/vodacthe/decal-unwrap | Period: Open Source
Context: Turns painted regions on 3D printable models into millimeter-accurate 1:1 flat paper templates to print, cut, and wrap physically around 3D prints.

Architectural Highlights:
- 100% client-side browser geometry pipeline supporting STL, OBJ, 3MF, PLY, and GLB files, plus 1:1 3D plate extrusion from scanned paper sketches.
- Includes ridge-aware fill/brush/cut painting tools, low-stretch surface flattening, multi-sheet nesting (A2–A6, Letter, Legal), and PDF/SVG/DXF export.

Stack: HTML5 / WebGL, 3D Mesh Unwrapping, Computational Geometry, SVG / PDF / DXF
Links: Live App (decal.vdthe.com) (https://decal.vdthe.com/) | GitHub Repo (https://github.com/vodacthe/decal-unwrap)

### FaceTrack 6-DoF — Android Head Tracker for Simulators [OPEN SOURCE · KOTLIN · 6-DOF TELEMETRY]
Organization / Source: github.com/vodacthe/face_track | Period: Open Source
Context: Low-latency 6-Degrees-of-Freedom (X/Y/Z translation + Yaw/Pitch/Roll rotation) camera head-tracking for flight, racing, and space simulators.

Architectural Highlights:
- Written in Kotlin for Android and engineered for compatibility with OpenTrack, FreeTrack 2.0 / TrackIR protocols, and SimHub.
- Streams smooth head-pose telemetry over UDP to simulation titles such as MSFS 2020/2024, DCS World, ETS2, and Assetto Corsa.

Stack: Kotlin, Android, 6-DoF Tracking, OpenTrack, FreeTrack 2.0 / UDP, SimHub
Links: GitHub Repo (https://github.com/vodacthe/face_track)

### vdt-sys-agent — Zero-Dependency Linux Hardware Telemetry Agent [OPEN SOURCE · PYTHON STDLIB · DEVOPS]
Organization / Source: github.com/vodacthe/vdt-sys-agent | Period: Open Source
Context: Lightweight, one-line-install Linux server monitoring agent feeding real-time node metrics into the VDT Enterprise dashboard without pip or external runtime bloat.

Architectural Highlights:
- Built exclusively on Python 3.8+ standard library exposing HTTP endpoints secured via auto-generated x-api-key authentication.
- Collects CPU, RAM, swap, disk, listening dev-server ports, top processes by CPU/RAM, and GPU metrics across NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel hardware.

Stack: Python 3 Stdlib, Linux Telemetry, HTTP / API Key Auth, GPU / Process Monitoring, Bash Installer
Links: GitHub Repo (https://github.com/vodacthe/vdt-sys-agent)
